generic_form.name: InvSpec[X,Y]
generic_form.validity: For each x in the declared domain, hypotheses(x) and absence of a named break condition entail the declared property relating x and transformation(x).

break_conditions: B(x) records known specification-level failure conditions separately from ordinary hypotheses
records.name: Generic invariant specification
nonclaims: This record shape is not itself a physical invariant.
Break-condition metadata does not replace proof of P.

records.name: Quarter-turn preserves integer squared norm
nonclaims: This exact algebraic result is not a theorem about arbitrary representation changes or physical conservation.
records.scope: all integer pairs Z^2; executable fixture is a conformance witness, not the universal proof

break_conditions: At the zero vector the inequality does not hold
records.name: Scaling counterexample to unqualified norm invariance
nonclaims: Failure under scale2 does not refute invariance under the narrower rotation action.

break_conditions: Changing the transition kernel, underlying initial distribution, or entropy functional would no longer isolate observation-map dependence

hypotheses: p1 is derived from p0 by the declared row-stochastic kernel K
Both partitions are complete and disjoint
The same p0, K, p1 trajectory is used for both observer comparisons
records.name: Observer-dependent Shannon sign counterexample
nonclaims: This does not violate data processing for one fixed deterministic observation map applied to one fixed distribution.
It shows that temporal entropy sign is not observer-independent when the observation contract changes.

records.scope: finite counterexample with one fixed declared fine-state dynamics
records.transformation: p1=p0 K, then compare that same fine trajectory under two declared coarse-graining partitions

records.transformation: Audit a claimed reversible map against declared inverse/bijectivity evidence
